entries.description: Checkbox and checkbox group

entries.description: Radio button and radio group

entries.title: Switch
entries.description: M3 Expressive switch with icon slots

entries.title: Text Field
entries.description: Filled and outlined text fields with floating labels

adaptations: Floating label animation uses Motion springs rather than CSS keyframes.
Shared field internals extracted for select parity (field-internals.ts).

entries.title: Card
entries.description: Elevated, filled, and outlined cards

entries.title: List
entries.description: M3 list and list items

entries.title: Divider
entries.description: Full-width, inset, and vertical dividers

entries.title: Badge
entries.description: Dot and numbered badges

entries.title: Tooltip
entries.description: Plain and rich tooltips

adaptations: Rich tooltip action slot tokens reserved; PreviewCard hosts rich content.

entries.title: Chip
entries.description: Assist, filter, input, and suggestion chips

entries.title: Segmented Button
entries.description: Single and multi-select segmented buttons

adaptations: Selected/unselected colors bound via Toggle pressed state.

entries.title: Slider
entries.description: Continuous, discrete, centered, range, and vertical sliders

adaptations: Thumb width transition uses Motion springs instead of CSS transitions.
Vertical orientation height is a web layout default.

entries.title: Menu
entries.description: Dropdown menu, context menu, and menubar

adaptations: Menu popup uses Material Web WAAPI: 500ms open with per-item stagger and upward translateY correction, 150ms close to 35% height, abort-signal interruption.

entries.title: Select
entries.description: M3 exposed dropdown menu styled as text field

adaptations: Field container styling shared with text-field via field-internals.ts.
Dropdown list reuses Menu WAAPI popup motion.

entries.title: Autocomplete
entries.description: Autocomplete and combobox with M3 text field styling

adaptations: Autocomplete field styling reuses text-field tokens; dedicated autocomplete container tokens are redundant on web.
Suggestion menu reuses menu container tokens.

entries.title: Progress
entries.description: Linear and circular progress indicators

adaptations: Wavy variant is an Expressive extension not shipped in stable MWC.
Wavy animation uses SVG path generation with Motion animation frames.

entries.title: Loading Indicator
entries.description: Expressive shape-cycling loader

adaptations: Expressive shape-cycling animation is Android-derived; not in Material Web.

entries.title: Snackbar
entries.description: Toast snackbars with queueing and positioning

adaptations: Toast queue, dismiss control, and viewport positioning are web-specific.
Container width follows content; no upstream min/max width tokens.

entries.title: Meter
entries.description: Meter styled consistently with progress indicators

adaptations: Meter reuses linear progress indicator track and active indicator tokens.

entries.title: Top App Bar
entries.description: Small, medium, large, and flexible Expressive top app bars

entries.title: Bottom App Bar
entries.description: Bottom app bar with action slots and attached FAB

adaptations: Hide-on-scroll behavior is a web extension.

entries.title: Navigation Bar
entries.description: Bottom navigation bar with active indicator pill and badges

adaptations: Vertical layout tokens unused; web bar uses horizontal item subset.

entries.title: Navigation Rail
entries.description: Collapsed, expanded, and modal navigation rail

adaptations: Expanded/modal layout tokens partially mapped to collapsed width defaults.

entries.title: Navigation Drawer
entries.description: Standard and modal navigation drawer with sections

adaptations: Badge overlay tokens delegated to Badge component.

entries.title: Tabs
entries.description: Primary and secondary tabs with scrollable layout

adaptations: Active indicator position uses Motion springs instead of CSS transitions.
Scrollable layout is a web composition pattern.

entries.title: Search
entries.description: Search bar and full-screen search view

adaptations: SearchBar suggestions reuse menu popup tokens; docked view max width follows header height token.

entries.title: Dialog
entries.description: Dialog, alert dialog, and full-screen dialog

adaptations: FullScreenDialog is a web layout adaptation beyond stable MWC basic dialog.
Dialog actions delegate to standard text Button; action-* dialog tokens are unused per upstream.
Dialog and AlertDialog use Material Web WAAPI open/close choreography; FullScreenDialog keeps Motion overlay.

entries.title: Bottom Sheet
entries.description: Modal bottom sheet with snap points and drag handle

adaptations: Snap points and drag gestures are web-specific; sheet-bottom-docked tokens drive visuals.

entries.title: Side Sheet
entries.description: Side sheet with header and action row

adaptations: Side sheet maps to navigation-drawer modal container tokens.

entries.title: Carousel
entries.description: M3 carousel layouts with scroll-linked resize

adaptations: Dedicated carousel tokens are Compose-only; slides use elevated-card container tokens.
Scroll-linked scale uses Motion; layout widths are percentage-based web defaults.

entries.title: Scaffold
entries.description: App layout composing chrome with inset CSS variables

adaptations: Inset CSS variables compose chrome; no dedicated scaffold tokens in upstream.

entries.title: Button Group
entries.description: Standard and connected button groups with neighbor bump

adaptations: Expressive neighbor bump uses shape morph springs beyond upstream token spec.

entries.title: Split Button
entries.description: Leading action with trailing menu trigger

entries.title: FAB Menu
entries.description: FAB expanding to labeled action list

adaptations: Shape morph pill expansion uses @m3ui/shapes; list items reuse fab-menu-baseline tokens.

entries.title: Toolbar
entries.description: Docked and floating toolbars with scroll hide/show

adaptations: Hide-on-scroll floating toolbar is a web extension.

entries.title: Date Input
entries.description: Locale-aware date input with Field validation

adaptations: Inline segments reuse text-field focus and container tokens.

entries.title: Date Picker
entries.description: Docked, modal, and range date pickers with calendar engine

adaptations: Calendar grid uses modal token subset; range selection is a web extension.

entries.title: Time Picker
entries.description: Dial and input time pickers with 12h/24h support

adaptations: Dial geometry reads clock-dial-container-size; inner/outer radii approximate Compose precision.
Period selector uses period-selector color tokens.

entries.title: Pane Scaffold
entries.description: List-detail and supporting-pane adaptive layouts

adaptations: Adaptive list-detail layout is a web composition pattern.

entries.title: Adaptive Navigation
entries.description: Auto-switching navigation bar, rail, and drawer

adaptations: Composes navigation-bar, navigation-rail, and navigation-drawer with window-size-class switching.

entries.title: Placeholder Button
entries.description: Registry placeholder for install testing

entries.title: Shapes
entries.description: Material Design 3 Expressive shape morphing, ShapeCrop, and the shapes library

adaptations: CSS clip-path and Motion springs adapt the Android Expressive shape system.
